{{recipe}}

This is a recipe for a homemade '''chocolate spread''', similar to [[Cookbook:Nutella|nutella]].

== Ingredients ==
* 100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 20 g [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]]
* 2 g [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 200 g [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 100 g dark [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]] (60% cocoa)
* 250 g raw [[Cookbook:Tahini|tahini]] or 200 g natural [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]]

==Procedure==
# Combine the sugar, cocoa powder, and salt in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
# Stir in part of the milk, then add the rest.
# Heat the mixture on the stove, stirring often until the sugar dissolves into the milk.
# Add the chocolate, and mix until dissolved.
# Turn off the stove, add the tahini/peanut butter, and mix well.
# Cool mixture and store in the fridge.
